Nora (billing): FYI - nightly sync created duplicate credit memos for ~29 customers. Stripe shows one refund id each but NetSuite has two CMs.
Diego (eng): Thanks. Any infra changes in the window?
ops-bot: deploy complete: release/2026-11-12-01:15 by @Diego
Diego (eng): We had a gateway tweak to canonicalize vendor headers. It lowercased some header names and trimmed whitespace. Our webhook verifier does a case-sensitive header lookup; mutated requests failed verification and were queued for replay.
Nora (billing): logs show verify-fail then replay creating duplicate CM: 
```nWARN billing:webhook - signature missing for evt_Abc123
INFO billing:replay - enqueued evt_Abc123 attempt=1
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit_memo CM-1201 for refund rf_Abc123
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit_memo CM-1202 for refund rf_Abc123 (replayed)
```
Diego (eng): Root cause: gateway header mutation + idempotency key that included full headers. Plan: 1) make signature lookup case-insensitive and tolerant to whitespace, 2) compute idempotency from stable fields (stripe_event_id + refund_id), 3) revert gateway header canonicalization for /webhooks.
Nora (billing): Can we auto-void the second CM where external_ref and amount match and created within 15 minutes? ~29 accounts. Need approval to run backfill.
finance-approvals: Approved for automated voids up to 50 accounts pending dry-run output.
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-13422 created: "Gateway header canonicalization -> webhook replay duplicates" assigned to Diego, priority P1
Diego (eng): Pushing hotfix to gateway and opening PR for idempotency change with tests. Will run dry-run after hotfix.
Nora (billing): Scheduling dry-run at 2213002400, backfill at 2213003600 once hotfix confirmed. Will post results to #finance-updates. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
